description.text:
The Shining Synergy GX Starter Deck (起始卡组 交相辉映GX) came out on 18 January 2023 with the three Shining Synergy booster packs. Each box held a 60-card deck ready to play, made up at random from 351 different non-holo cards, and a one-card bonus pack for swapping a card into the deck. The bonus card was one of 40, 25 non-holo and 15 holo, and the holos were the rarer pull.

The deck's cards are numbered out of 342. Fifteen holo cards are numbered past that, 343 to 357: full-art Vileplume GX, Flygon GX, Erika's Hospitality, Judge, TV Reporter, Sophocles and Welder, rainbow Celebi & Venusaur GX, Vileplume GX, Dedenne GX, Marshadow & Machamp GX and Melmetal GX, and gold Judge Whistle, Fiery Flint and Counter Gain.

Its Guzma & Hala (301/342) was misprinted with the wrong character in Guzma's name, 古兹玛 for 古兹马; it is still legal, and Pokémon exchanged copies from 18 January to 18 July 2023. Its Sky Pillar (339/342) shows regulation mark C where it should show B. It plays as B and was not replaced.
